Breaking Cycles & Improving Outcomes
Therapeutic Fostering, Residential Homes & Education
Therapeutic Childcare in Kent
Welcome to Channels & Choices
Channels & Choices was established in 2005 by a group of qualified social workers who were, and still are, passionate about making a difference to the lives of children in care.
Therapeutic Fostering
A small but personal fostering agency for new and existing carers in Kent.
Residential Children's Homes
Family sized children's homes in Dover, Deal and Sandwich.
Independent SEMH School
The Sallygate School, Independent DfE registered school for children with SEMH needs.
About Us
Initially starting with one residential home, Channels & Choices has grown into a centre of excellence in therapeutic children's services across Kent, supporting children and young people with complex emotional, social, and behavioural needs. We offer high-quality fostering placements and nurturing residential children's homes, underpinned by a trauma-informed, therapeutic approach. With an on-site SEMH school and a multi-disciplinary therapy team working collaboratively, we create safe, stable environments where children can heal, grow, and achieve their full potential. Our integrated model ensures care, education, and therapy work seamlessly together to deliver truly child-centred support.
Why Choose Us
Evidence-based support that makes a real difference
Trauma Informed
Evidence-based therapeutic approaches tailored to each child
Step down to fostering
Unique Stepping Stones program to prepare children for family living
Education Placement

Breaking Cycles & Improving Outcomes
Community Events
Smiles, teamwork, and shared memories - our community comes together to support our foster families, the children in our residential homes and the pupils of The Sallygate School. At Channels & Choices the children in our community thrive, have fun and forge friendships at our numerous community events.
Our Approach
Trauma-Informed Practice
Evidence-based approaches that recognize and respond to the impact of trauma
Therapeutic Community
Highly integrated therapeutic support woven into every aspect of care
Understanding Attachment
Deep understanding of attachment experiences and early life trauma
Breaking Cycles
Helping children develop emotional management skills and reach their full potential
Our Leadership
Our dedicated leadership team brings together decades of expertise in therapeutic care, education, and fostering.

Kate Stephenson

Join Our Team
At Channels & Choices, we’re looking for passionate, dedicated professionals who share our commitment to transforming the lives of children with complex social, emotional and mental health needs. Whether you’re an experienced teacher, therapist, or support worker, we’d love to hear from you.
Why Work With Us
Make a genuine, lasting difference to vulnerable children’s lives every day.
Join a therapeutic community that values, supports, and develops every member of the team.
Access specialist training from leading professionals in trauma-informed care and child development.
Work in small, homely settings where genuine relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
Be part of an Ofsted Outstanding organisation with a strong reputation across Kent and the South East.

Deputy Manager – Children’s Home
DEPUTY MANAGER – CHILDREN’S HOME
Responsible To: Registered Manager
Starting salary of £44,907 per annum.
Permanent, Full time Position – minimum of 37.5 hours per week, including 2 sleep-ins.
£1,000 Bonus for an Outstanding Ofsted rating.
Travel allowance of up to £40 per week.
(Salary does include 2 sleep-ins per week at £60 for each sleep-in and a yearly on-call payment of £1,500)
Perks, Rewards and Benefits
Start a rewarding career in management! Due to company expansion, we have some great opportunities for aspiring managers.
Are you Deputy Manager looking for a new challenge or a Senior Shift Leader with aspirations to progress? We have some fantastic career opportunities for you in one of our Outstanding Children’s homes based in East Kent.
Channels and Choices Therapeutic Community aims to be a Centre of Excellence in Child Care and Education. We are an award winning, dynamic company specialising in children’s residential care, Fostering and Education based in South East Kent. OFSTED judge our services as ‘Good’ or ‘Outstanding’. We are committed to safeguarding the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
What does the job involve?
As the Deputy Manager of our Residential Children’s Home, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Registered Manager in efficiently co-managing the home. This is a physically and mentally demanding role that will challenge and reward you.
You will oversee the development of staff and young people in placement, formulate and update placement plans, risk assessments, and positive handling plans. Your leadership will contribute to the delivery of high-quality service provision and promoting the Company’s therapeutic ethos.
What we are looking for:
We have a strong commitment to staff development and there will be considerable opportunities for internal and external training and for sharing good practice within the community.
Duties & Responsibilities
We are looking for candidates who have proven skills and experience in a Residential Care Setting or equivalent setting and are passionate about improving the lives and outcomes for children and young people. We promote the well-being of our young people through a wide and varied programme of activities, sports, and hobbies.
If you’re looking for a rewarding career and the chance to make a real difference to children who need it the most, apply to work for Channels & Choices today. After a successful initial application, we’ll invite you in for an informal interview.
What are you waiting for? Apply online today.
Channels and Choices are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of the young people in our care. Staff are all required to adhere to the organisation’s Safeguarding Policies and Procedures. This post will be subject to a satisfactory Enhanced DBS Disclosure, an employment background check, satisfactory references & verification of a right to work in the UK. As part of our commitment to Safer Recruitment, CV’s cannot be considered without a completed application form.
Channels & Choices are committed to ensuring that we are always recruiting, retaining, and promoting a diverse mix of colleagues who are representative of the diversity in our local community. We actively celebrate our staff’s different abilities, sexual orientation, ethnicity, faith, and gender. Everyone is welcome to apply for a job with Channels & Choices and our staff are supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

Learning Mentor
£25,480.59 FTE + SEN Allowance £2,679 – 39 weeks out of 52
The Sallygate School is an Independent Special School catering to the unique needs of pupils with SEMH. Located in the heart of the Alkham Valley, near Dover, the Sallygate School is part of Channels & Choices Therapeutic Community which comprises of several therapeutic residential children’s homes, an independent therapeutic fostering agency and a multi-disciplinary therapy service, including SaLT & OT service.
As a Learning Mentor at Sallygate School, you will play a vital role in supporting the social, emotional and academic development of children and young people with Social, Emotional and Mental Health (SEMH) needs. Working as part of a dedicated multidisciplinary team, you will build trusting relationships with pupils, helping them to overcome barriers to learning, develop resilience, and thrive within a safe, nurturing, and aspirational school environment.
You will provide structured mentoring support both in and outside the classroom, contribute to behaviour regulation strategies, promote positive engagement in learning, and act as a key adult for pupils requiring individualised interventions. Using trauma-informed, attachment-aware, and therapeutic approaches, you will guide pupils in managing their emotions, building self-esteem, and developing the personal and interpersonal skills needed for success in education and life.
At the heart of this role is a commitment to modelling and promoting our core values of Respect, Kindness, Resilience and Tolerance. These values shape every interaction we have with our pupils and with one another. As a Learning Mentor, you will actively demonstrate these values by showing unconditional positive regard, promoting restorative relationships, encouraging perseverance, and fostering an inclusive environment where difference is celebrated and everyone is treated with dignity.
This role requires compassion, creativity, and the ability to remain calm and consistent in challenging situations. It is ideal for someone who believes in restorative practices, co-regulation, and the power of strong, respectful relationships to transform outcomes for vulnerable learners.
The Learning Mentor will support the personal, social and educational development of pupils who may be facing barriers to engagement. Working across the school day, the postholder will act as a consistent, caring adult, contributing to a positive, safe, and inclusive learning environment for all pupils.

Family-sized childrens homes in Dover, Deal and Sandwich
Safe and welcoming spaces
A Therapeutic Residential Model That Works
Residential Care
Channels & Choices operates a network of Ofsted-registered children's homes across Kent and the South East, each providing therapeutic care for children aged 8–17 with complex social, emotional and behavioural needs.
Choose Your Pathway
Explore what residential care means for you.
Working in Our Homes
Join a skilled, passionate team and make a real difference to the lives of children in residential care.
For Local Authorities
Trusted therapeutic placements with measurable outcomes and comprehensive reporting for placing authorities.
Our Impact
Discover how our therapeutic model creates lasting change and outstanding outcomes for the children we care for.
A Therapeutic Residential Model That Works
Our homes are small by design, offering high staffing ratios and close, consistent relationships with experienced carers and therapists. Every home follows an attachment-aware, trauma-informed model, with integrated access to therapy and education through the Channels & Choices School and Clinical Team.
What Makes Our Homes Unique
Integrated Therapeutic Community
Complete in-house model including residential care, fostering, specialist schooling, and dedicated therapy services — ensuring consistent, joined-up support.
Skilled and Stable Teams
Staff trained in attachment, trauma and positive behaviour support, with strong supervision and retention.
Personalised Care Pathways
Bespoke therapeutic plans with clear outcomes, supported by our clinical and education teams.
High-Quality Environments
Small, calm, well-furnished homes with high staffing ratios to reduce anxiety and support regulation.
Proven Outcomes and Regulatory Excellence
All homes Ofsted-registered, with inspections rated Good and a track record of Outstanding performance.
Daily Life in Our Homes
Healing in Everyday Moments
Each of our homes offers a warm, safe and welcoming space where children can learn, grow and feel grounded. Our settings range from quiet rural locations to well-connected urban areas, chosen to suit each child's needs and preferences.
Therapeutic support is built into daily routines, mealtimes and activities — because healing happens in everyday moments. Staff create a genuine home atmosphere where children feel comfortable, valued and encouraged to try new things.
Children take part in sports, hobbies and everyday activities that build confidence, resilience and social skills. From cooking and gardening to creative projects and community events, we help each child discover their strengths and interests.
Therapeutic routines built into everyday life
Activities that build confidence and resilience
Warm, home-like atmospheres across all settings
Our Staffing Approach
Highly trained, stable teams providing intensive support and consistent relationships.
Minimum 1:1 Ratio
Intensive supervision ensuring every child receives close attention and consistent support.
Professional Standards
Members of professional Therapeutic Communities organisations, committed to evidence-based practice.
Ongoing Supervision
Regular support from experienced house managers ensuring quality care and staff wellbeing.
All our homes operate with a minimum 1:1 adult to child ratio, ensuring that every young person receives the close attention, support and supervision they need to feel safe and make progress. This intensive staffing model allows our teams to respond therapeutically to challenging moments and provide consistent, nurturing relationships.
Our staff are trained to high standards in attachment, trauma and positive behaviour support, and receive ongoing supervision from experienced house managers. We are proud members of professional Therapeutic Communities organisations, reflecting our commitment to evidence-based practice and continuous improvement.
Staff stability is central to our approach. We invest in recruiting, training and retaining skilled teams who understand the importance of consistency and can build trusted, long-term relationships with the children they support.
Building Secure Attachments
Healing Through Safe Relationships
We believe children heal and thrive through safe, nurturing relationships. Many who come to us have experienced disrupted attachments or trauma, and need support to rebuild trust and form healthy connections.
Our homes offer a "secure base" — a stable, predictable environment where children feel safe, understood and valued. With consistent, attuned care from trusted adults, they develop stronger emotional regulation, social skills and a genuine sense of belonging.
This therapeutic approach shapes every interaction. Our team is trained to recognise attachment needs and respond with techniques that build safety, connection and resilience. In time, children learn they can rely on adults, and that relationships can bring comfort instead of fear.
Secure base approach to every placement
Trauma-informed practice throughout
Consistent, trusted adult relationships
Our Assessment and Planning Process
Initial Assessment
Every child receives a robust initial assessment when they join us. We take time to understand their history, needs, strengths and goals, working closely with placing authorities and families to ensure a thorough picture.
Specialist Assessments
Where needed, we arrange psychological and psychiatric assessments through our clinical team or trusted partners, ensuring that complex needs are properly understood and addressed.
Personalised Treatment Plans
Based on our assessments, we develop detailed, personalised treatment plans with clear goals and strategies. These plans guide the daily work of our residential, education and therapy teams.
Coordinated Support
Our integrated model means that therapy, education and residential care are coordinated seamlessly, with regular reviews and adjustments to ensure every child's plan remains responsive to their changing needs.
Pathways to Family Living
Seamless transitions and continuous support from residential to foster care.
The Stepping Stone Model
For many children, residential care is an important stepping stone on the journey towards family-based living. We work closely with our in-house fostering service to provide seamless transitions from residential to foster care when a child is ready.
This model allows children to build skills, confidence and emotional stability in a residential setting, while gradually preparing for the more family-focused environment of foster care. Because both services are part of Channels & Choices, we can ensure continuity of relationships, education and therapy throughout the transition.
Our integrated approach significantly reduces the risk of placement breakdown. Children move between settings with familiar staff support, continued access to their school and therapists, and a clear plan that recognises their progress and next steps.
Seamless transitions between residential and foster care
Continuity of relationships, education and therapy
Significantly reduced risk of placement breakdown
Our Mission
To invest in building the future capacity to care for children by creating calm, nurturing homes that restore trust, promote stability and inspire growth.
Ofsted-Registered and Quality Assured
All Channels & Choices residential homes are Ofsted-registered and run under the oversight of our Operational Director and Responsible Individual. Our homes have achieved Outstanding and Good in recent inspections and our specialist school holds a Good rating with Outstanding areas. This regulatory assurance means placing authorities can be confident in the safety, governance and therapeutic quality of our homes.
Ofsted has specifically rated children's experiences and progress in our homes as Outstanding, recognising the positive impact of our therapeutic model on children's wellbeing, development and future prospects. This reflects our commitment to achieving meaningful, lasting outcomes for every child in our care.

All our homes are fully registered and compliant with Ofsted regulatory requirements.
